justification: The historical outcome was that naming remained unresolved and open into a fourth round, with no lasting decision made (the API name only became locked by default, not chosen as the customer-facing solution). The candidate instead proposes a concrete resolution mechanism—convening veto-holders, adopting the API name as the plain-English basis, pairing with UX copy, and forcibly locking the decision as final—which is a substantively different outcome than the historical pattern of continued unresolved reopening.
